list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) FROM public.ai_calls WHERE ref_type = 'benchmark' ORDER BY 1
list.label: Usage key
list.name: usage_key
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) FROM public.ai_calls WHERE ref_type = 'benchmark' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pass rate by usage key and model
panels.description: Which named model answers which usage key best. One row per usage key and model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) AS "Usage key", model AS "Model", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "Pass rate %", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok IS NOT NULL) AS "Cases", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok IS FALSE) AS "Failed" FROM public.ai_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ref_type = 'benchmark' AND outcome <> 'skipped' AND split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) LIKE ANY (ARRAY[$usage_key]) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

panels.title: Cost per model
panels.description: What the benchmark of each model cost, and how fast it answered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 6) AS "Cost USD", COUNT(*) AS "Cases", ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)) AS "Avg ms" FROM public.ai_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ref_type = 'benchmark' AND outcome <> 'skipped' AND split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) LIKE ANY (ARRAY[$usage_key]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Pass rate over time
panels.description: A model's pass rate over time: a drop after a route change is the signal to read.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, model AS "Model", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "Pass rate %" FROM public.ai_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ref_type = 'benchmark' AND outcome <> 'skipped' AND split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) LIKE ANY (ARRAY[$usage_key]) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cases per day
panels.description: How many benchmark cases ran each day, and how many passed or errored.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Cases", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_ok) AS "Passed", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE error_type IS NOT NULL) AS "Errors" FROM public.ai_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ref_type = 'benchmark' AND outcome <> 'skipped' AND split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) LIKE ANY (ARRAY[$usage_key]) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency per model
panels.description: How long each model took to answer the frozen cases.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, model AS "Model", ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)) AS "Avg ms", ROUND(MAX(latency_ms)) AS "Max ms" FROM public.ai_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ref_type = 'benchmark' AND outcome <> 'skipped' AND split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) LIKE ANY (ARRAY[$usage_key]) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failing cases by usage key
panels.description: The cases that did not pass, with the reason, newest first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) AS "Usage key", model AS "Model", ref_kind AS "Case", COALESCE(error_type, 'check failed') AS "Why" FROM public.ai_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ref_type = 'benchmark' AND outcome <> 'skipped' AND split_part(usage_key, ':', 2) LIKE ANY (ARRAY[$usage_key]) AND parse_ok IS FALSE ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200
